outcome.reason: All14 entrants and8 server events pass exact source/resource/campaign/transport/smoke/scoring checks. Every timed identity aggregate matches its separately retained and semantically verified probe.

scores.rule: Formula 1 points 25,18,15,12,10,8,6,4,2,1; ties share their positions' points. Server = events 1-8 (event 7 has two parts, image size and gzip bytes, each scored apart at half weight), Client = 9-11, Overall = stacks (a server car with the client cars of the UI library it ships, Amendment 2), points per event entered.

metric.name: peak resident memory under Sprint load

transport.limitation: Every smoke and event probe body is retained and semantically checked; all warmups and timed samples retain complete oha output, explicit request headers, arguments, exact aggregate body bytes and completed-request denominators. Individual timed bodies are not retained; this proves representation size consistency alongside sampled semantic correctness, not byte-for-byte identity of every timed body.

privacy.limitation: Pattern scan plus source/provenance review; not a general proof of arbitrary binary secrecy.

limitations: Every smoke and event probe body is retained and semantically checked; all warmups and timed samples retain complete oha output, explicit request headers, arguments, exact aggregate body bytes and completed-request denominators. Individual timed bodies are not retained; this proves representation size consistency alongside sampled semantic correctness, not byte-for-byte identity of every timed body.
Build CPU affinity is bound by the exact driver command and recorded profile; short-lived --rm build containers have no retained Docker inspect record.
No comparison with the earlier diagnostic run or another campaign is made. This is a frozen published-3.0.0 baseline, not an integrated-candidate race.
